About Couple Better Gifts

Couple Better Gifts is an independent student web-business project developed for a BYU–Idaho class. It is not an official university store, an Amazon service, or a retailer. Its purpose is to help adult shoppers make more considered gift choices for teens and adults.

What the finder does

The quiz narrows a fixed collection of gift concepts by planning budget, recipient age band, interests, and gift style. Everyone can explore every interest; gender does not restrict the gift categories. The results are a starting point for shopping, not a guarantee that a particular product will fit.

How the content is made

The website and buying guidance were developed with AI assistance. The live quiz does not generate new ideas with AI. It uses stored gift entries and transparent matching rules. The guides explain tradeoffs, compatibility checks, and circumstances where a gift may be a poor choice.

These are buying guides, not reviews based on personally testing products. Where a technical point is illustrated with a manufacturer’s manual or official game rules, the guide links to that source. A specific Amazon listing previously checked for product identity still needs to be checked again for price, availability, seller, and compatibility at purchase time.

What qualifies an idea for the collection

  • A clear connection to an interest or an existing routine.
  • A stated use and a buying check that could change the decision.
  • A rough planning budget rather than an invented current price.
  • No claim of personal testing, guaranteed quality, or official licensing without evidence.

Search links are labeled as searches. Direct links are labeled as specific listings. Product names, licensed characters, and brands belong to their respective owners. Inclusion does not imply their endorsement of this site.

How the site earns money

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Some shopping links include an affiliate tracking ID. A qualifying purchase can earn this site a commission. Display advertising is limited to the complete buying guides; the quiz, help dialog, and information pages do not load Google’s advertising script.

Amazon or the listing’s seller handles checkout, delivery, returns, and customer service. This site does not collect payment details, place orders, or ship products.

Limits and corrections

Gift budgets are estimates for categories, and the collection is designed for recipients aged 13 and older. Always confirm current seller details and applicable product instructions. We do not currently offer a public contact form or support inbox. For order help, contact Amazon or the seller through the order page.
